goal.text: Asher's stated goal is for the company to run 90-95% autonomously.

figure.intro: These operational measures describe recorded sessions and decisions. They do not establish a company autonomy rate.

metrics.label: Completion among executor sessions with valid recorded counts
metrics.blurb: Sessions the system recorded as completed, including work that ended at a review or delivery boundary. Coverage is incomplete.
metrics.method: Paired nonnegative integer attempted/completed counters from 193 loop-run records; counts exceeding attempts are excluded. 32 records have missing counters, 0 have invalid counters, and 0 lines are malformed. 35 observed completions with no attempt count are excluded from both totals. The date window describes included records with valid timestamps. Completion is the chassis's recorded session result, not independent acceptance, founder time or company autonomy.

metrics.shortLabel: Work aimed at clients and products
metrics.blurb: Of the sessions with a written report, the share aimed at client work and products rather than at the vault itself.
metrics.label: Sessions aimed at client and product work rather than at the system itself (among sessions with a run report)
metrics.method: Counts each "## <task-id> — <project-slug> (...)" session header the chassis writes into its own run reports (Mechanical/logs/executor-runs/*.md, 18 files, 2026-08-17 to 2026-09-07); every slug other than "vault" (Projects/meta/vault) counts as outward.

metrics.blurb: The share of logged decisions explicitly recorded as proceeding after the founder’s veto window passed. This does not measure how much he shaped the choice.
metrics.label: Logged choices recorded as proceeding without a founder veto
metrics.method: Of 23 dated decision-log entries, 2 carry the literal promotion phrase "decided by the ghost, veto window passed". The denominator includes all dated entries, not only queued choices. This measures recorded non-veto promotions, not absence of founder involvement; an entry without the phrase is unclassified by this proxy.

Dog Body Mind: push the verified test work; port the pattern per-project, not as one sweep

metrics.blurb: Documentation claims that no longer matched the code when checked.
metrics.label: Documentation claims that no longer matched the code when audited
metrics.method: Sum of the "N drift item(s)" / "N claim(s) checked" counters the Arbiter writes into its own "## checked" section per project per run (Mechanical/logs/arbiter-runs/*.md, 18 of 21 files carry a checked section, 2026-08-17 to 2026-09-05). A claim is a documentation assertion the Arbiter verified against running code that tick; drift is a claim it found false. Real code defects the Arbiter also flags that were never a documentation claim are not counted here.
